Gifting Store · Case study

Customise World

A personalised-gifting and wedding-hamper brand growing entirely on organic reach. One reel alone brought in 300+ new followers with no ad spend.

  • 300+Followers from a single reel, organically
  • 0Ad spend on that growth
  • OrganicGrowth strategy
challenge

Customise World sells premium personalised gifting — baby announcements, wedding hampers, corporate boxes. The brief was growth without a media budget: the content itself had to do the work.

approach

We focused the feed on a few formats that travel — premium unboxing-style reels, announcement reels, and factory/behind-the-scenes cuts — and paired it with a properly designed 2025 digital catalogue and company profile so enquiries could be closed.

result

Steady organic follower growth, including 300+ new followers from a single baby-announcement reel, and a sales toolkit that looks as premium as the product.
